title: Justy #1 Viz Comics 1988 - The Tears Of Astalis, Part 1 - By Tsuguo Okazaki
descriptionText: The product is a Viz Comics publication from 1988 titled "The Tears of Astalis, Part 1" by Tsuguo Okazaki. This comic book is part of the "Justy" series and falls under the genre of comics. Published by Marvel, this collectible item is a must-have for fans of US Comics and graphic novels. With its unique storyline and artwork by Tsuguo Okazaki, this comic book is sure to be a valuable addition to any comic book collection.
